message.content: The title of “best player” in soccer is always debated and depends on criteria—goal‑scoring, overall influence, trophies, or individual skill. As of now (mid‑2026), many consider **Lionel Messi** still the most dominant figure in the sport, thanks to his record‑breaking goal tally, play‑making ability, and recent success with Inter Miami and the Argentine national team. Other top contenders include **Kylian Mbappé**, who combines speed, finishing, and a growing trophy cabinet, and **Erling Haaland**, whose goal‑scoring rate has been unprecedented. Ultimately, the “best” player varies by personal preference and the specific aspects of the game you value most.
